data.one_liner: A Dart filter to check if a string contains English bad words and clean them.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Filter class to check strings for profane English words. Also allows cleaning profane strings by replacing bad words with asterisks.
use_when: You need to validate user-generated input for English profanity
You want to censor or mask bad words in text strings
avoid_when: You need support for languages other than English
You need advanced NLP or context-aware sentiment analysis
strengths: Includes both checking and cleaning functionality
weaknesses: Word list is static and defined internally
